what: R7 rounds of the outer top edge and the inside edge of a 2 mm wall in one fillet: the inside round holds the material the outer one runs over, so the wall stays closed
method: as 1668-fillet-both-sides-of-thin-wall at R7: the inside (concave) round adds (1-pi/4) 49 along 100 about (23, 33); the outer one's part over the hollow lies at least 9.7 from (23, 33), inside the added material, so it takes its whole section (1-pi/4) 49 along 104. V = 39552 - (1-pi/4) 49 x 4 = 39509.938040, exact: the tolerance holds it to 0.04 mm^3
